text:
KOREAN CRISPY CHICKEN - SANS FRITURE ! 🍗🔥

Du poulet ultra-croustillant, une viande bien juteuse et un glaçage BBQ-gochujang brillant et légèrement épicé… Le genre de recette qui te fait oublier que t’as même pas sorti la friteuse. 🤤

Et grâce à la cuisson à l’air fryer, on peut économiser une quantité importante d’huile par rapport à une friture traditionnelle, sans sacrifier la gourmandise !

👨‍🍳 Préparation (4 à 5 pièces)
⏱ Prépa : 20 min + marinade 20-30 min | Cuisson : 20 min

1️⃣ La marinade
Mélange 500 g de hauts de cuisse désossés sans peau avec 15 g de sauce soja, 5 g de paprika doux, 3 g d’ail en poudre, 2 g de gingembre en poudre, 1 g de cumin, 0,5 g de Cayenne et 10 g de jus de citron vert. Marine 20-30 min au frais.

2️⃣ La panure
Mélange 60 g de farine, 60 g de fécule, 3 g de paprika doux, 2 g d’ail en poudre et 2 g de sel. Bats 2 œufs à part. Passe chaque morceau dans l’œuf, puis dans la panure, et répète une seconde fois pour une croûte bien épaisse et irrégulière !

3️⃣ La cuisson
Dispose les morceaux dans l’air fryer, vaporise avec 8-12 g d’huile et cuis 18-20 min à 190°C, en retournant à mi-cuisson. Le poulet doit atteindre 74°C à cœur.

4️⃣ Le glaze BBQ-gochujang
Mélange 50 g de sauce BBQ sans sucres ajoutés, 20 g de gochujang, 5 g d’huile de sésame et 15 g d’eau chaude jusqu’à un glaçage lisse et brillant. Dès que le poulet est cuit, enrobe-le généreusement de glaze.

🔥 Version au four
210°C chaleur tournante, morceaux sur une grille, 10-15 g d’huile en spray, 25-30 min en retournant à mi-cuisson. Option : 2-3 min sous le gril avant le glaçage.

💡 Et côté calories ?
L’air fryer utilise beaucoup moins d’huile qu’un bain de friture. Selon l’absorption d’huile et la panure, l’économie calorique peut être significative, potentiellement de l’ordre de 30 à 40 % par rapport à une version frite comparable.

Personnellement, j’ai HORREUR d’éplucher mes pommes de terre à chaque repas. 😂 Alors voici ma petite astuce meal prep pour gagner du temps !

🥔 Comment je prépare mes pommes de terre à l’avance :

1. J’épluche plusieurs pommes de terre d’un coup.
2. Je les place entières dans un récipient propre, rempli d’eau froide, en veillant à ce qu’elles soient complètement immergées.
3. Je ferme le récipient et je le conserve au réfrigérateur (4 °C maximum) pendant 24 à 48 heures maximum.
4. Quand j’en ai besoin, je n’ai plus qu’à les égoutter, les découper en frites et surtout BIEN les sécher avant la cuisson au Air Fryer !

Résultat : des frites maison croustillantes sans avoir à tout éplucher à chaque repas ! 🍟

💡 Petit rappel : les pommes de terre n’empêchent absolument pas de perdre du gras ! Grâce à leur faible densité calorique et leur pouvoir rassasiant, elles peuvent même être un excellent allié pour optimiser ta sèche, en facilitant le maintien d’un déficit calorique sans frustration. Tout dépend évidemment de la préparation et des quantités consommées 🫡

Des bouchées ultra-croustillantes, épicées et riches en protéines pour un apéro qui change ? 🔥🤤 

📝 Recette pour 4 personnes : 
🍗 150 g de blanc de poulet 
🫘 125 g de pois chiches cuits 
🧄 1 gousse d’ail frais 
🧅 1 oignon jaune 
🌶️ 1 c. à café de paprika 
🌿 1 c. à café de cumin 
🌱 1 c. à café de coriandre en poudre 
🫚 ½ c. à café de gingembre en poudre 
🥢 1 c. à soupe de sauce soja 
🔥 1 pincée de piment d’Espelette 
🧂 Sel naturel et poivre 
🍚 6 feuilles de riz  

1. Rincer et égoutter les pois chiches, puis éplucher l’oignon et l’ail. 
2. Dans un mixeur, ajouter le poulet, les pois chiches, l’oignon, l’ail, les épices, la sauce soja, le sel et le poivre. Mixer jusqu’à obtenir une farce homogène. 
3. Tremper deux feuilles de riz quelques secondes dans l’eau tiède, puis les superposer à plat sur un plan de travail. 
4. Déposer de la farce au centre, rabattre les côtés et rouler bien serré. Recommencer avec les feuilles restantes. 
5. Cuire au Air Fryer pendant 15 à 20 min à 190 °C (ou au four à 200 °C), jusqu’à obtenir des bouchées bien dorées et croustillantes.

Per Serving (Makes 5)

Chipotle Chicken:
900g skinless chicken thighs (32oz)

Season heavily: Chipotle or ancho chili powder, garlic powder, onion powder, black pepper, salt

Fajita Veggies:
2 bell peppers
1/2 yellow onion

Rice:
300g / 2 cups rice (dry weight)
Or ~580g pre-cooked rice 

Finishing Ingredients:
60g reduced fat mozzarella (1/2 cup)
60g extra sharp cheddar (1/2 cup)
100g 0% Greek yogurt (1/2 cup)
Handful chopped cilantro

Smokey Chipotle Sauce:
180g 0% Greek yogurt (3/4 cup)
60g milk (1/4 cup)
7g honey (1 tsp)
45g adobo sauce (3 Tbsp)
Smoked paprika to taste
Salt to taste

-

Instructions

1.) In a bowl, mix chicken thighs with avocado oil, hot honey, lime juice, and all seasonings. Toss until evenly coated.

2.) Cook chicken in an air fryer at 375°F for 20-25 mins, flipping halfway, until cooked through and lightly charred. Remove and chop into bite-sized pieces.

3.) Remove the air fryer rack. Add diced bell peppers, onion, oil, and tomato paste directly to the basket. Air fry at 350°F for 10–15 minutes, stirring once or twice, until softened and lightly browned.

4.) Add cooked rice directly to the veggies in the air fryer basket (or transfer to a large bowl). Stir in mozzarella, cheddar, and Greek yogurt until melted and creamy. Add chopped chicken and cilantro. Mix until evenly combined.

5.) Whisk together Greek yogurt, milk, honey, adobo sauce, salt and smoked paprika until smooth.

6.) Divide into 5 equal servings and top each with smoky chipotle sauce.

Air Fryer Sweet Potato Chicken Bowls 🍗🍠

Click the link in my biofor more info on my 12-week fat loss program that kicks off November 2nd! 💪

Macros 🔥 (per bowl – Makes 4)

Ingredients 🥣 (Makes 4)

Air Fryer Basket 🍗
26 oz or 750g Chicken Breast, raw
18 oz or 500g Sweet Potatoes, raw (diced small)
1 medium or ~110g Red Onion
2 cups or 250g Broccoli (Frozen or Fresh)

High Protein Sauce 🥣

How to Make 🧑‍🍳
1️⃣ Dice your chicken breast and sweet potatoes into bite-sized pieces. Add to your air fryer basket along with the broccoli and diced red onion. Spray with olive oil, season, and mix until evenly coated.
2️⃣ Air fry at 400°F (200°C) or bake at 450°F (230°C) for 20–22 minutes, tossing halfway through, until the chicken reaches 165°F (75°C) and the sweet potatoes are fork-tender.
3️⃣ While that’s cooking, combine your Greek yogurt, lemon juice, hot sauce, and seasonings in a bowl. Add water until you reach your desired consistency.
4️⃣ Once everything is fully cooked, divide evenly into 4 meal prep containers and drizzle your high-protein sauce over top. Enjoy!

Storage

Crispy Air Fryer Cottage Cheese Protein Bites 🧀🔥✨

High protein, ultra crispy, and ridiculously addictive! These Air Fryer Cottage Cheese Protein Bites turn a tub of cottage cheese into the ultimate crunchy snack with zero guilt. Hit save right now to satisfy your savoury cravings! 🙌🔥

🚨 EXCITING NEWS, CLUB MEMBERS! The Air Fryer Club app is launching on the 30th of October, featuring over 500 tested recipes just like this one! Make sure you are following so you never miss a drop! 📱💥

The Recipe: Crispy Cottage Cheese Protein Bites

Prep Time: 20 mins (draining)

Cook Time: 11–14 mins

Cooling Time: 10 mins

Makes: 12 bites (Serves 2)

Ingredients:

* 250g full-fat cottage cheese, well drained
* 1/2 tsp garlic powder
* 1/2 tsp smoked paprika
* Pinch of dried chilli flakes (optional)
* Pinch of salt
* Black pepper, to taste
* Oil spray

Method:

1. Drain & Season: Drain cottage cheese in a fine sieve for 20 minutes to remove excess whey. Mix with garlic powder, smoked paprika, chilli flakes, salt, and pepper.
2. Prep Basket: Remove the crisper plate and spray basket lightly with oil spray.
3. Portion: Drop small spoonfuls into the basket, leaving space between each. Flatten each scoop as thin as possible with the back of a spoon. Work in batches.
4. Air Fry: Air fry at 190°C for 11–14 minutes until deep golden at the edges and dry in the centre.
5. Cool to Crisp: Let cool for at least 10 minutes before removing with a spatula. They crisp up completely as they cool!

Nutritional Facts (Per Serving - 6 bites):

* Calories: approx. 125 kcal
* Protein: approx. 14g
* Carbs: approx. 4.5g
* Fat: approx. 5.5g

Club Tip: Draining the cheese and letting them cool completely are the two golden rules! Draining removes moisture so they crisp rather than steam, and the cooling time is when that shatteringly loud crunch locks in. Tag us in your story so we can hear that crunch! 🧀✨

🍗 POLLO FRITO SALUDABLE ESTILO KFC

INGREDIENTES (PARA 1 RACIÓN):

🍗 1 Pechuga de pollo (250-300 gr aprox.)
🥛 1 Yogur griego natural
🧄 Ajo en polvo al gusto
🫚 Jengibre en polvo al gusto
🫙 Pimienta negra al gusto
🥄 Pimentón dulce al gusto
🌿 Orégano al gusto
🧂 Sal al gusto
🌾 40-50 gr de Cereales de trigo para rebozar

PARA LA SALSA:

🥄 2 cucharadas de Mostaza
🥄 1 cucharada de Ketchup zero
🍯 1 cucharada de Miel

👨‍🍳 PASO A PASO

1️⃣ CORTAMOS EL POLLO

Cortamos la pechuga en tiras de un grosor parecido para que se cocinen de manera uniforme.

2️⃣ MARINAMOS EL POLLO

En un bowl añadimos el pollo, un yogur griego natural y las especias: ajo, jengibre, pimienta, pimentón dulce, orégano y sal.

3️⃣ DEJAMOS REPOSAR

Mezclamos todo bien hasta que el pollo quede completamente impregnado y lo dejamos en la nevera durante al menos 30 minutos.

4️⃣ PREPARAMOS EL EMPANADO

Echamos los cereales de trigo en un bowl y los trituramos con las manos hasta conseguir trocitos pequeños para que el pollo quede crujiente.

5️⃣ REBOZAMOS EL POLLO

Sacamos el pollo de la nevera y pasamos cada tira por los cereales triturados, presionando ligeramente para que se queden bien adheridos.

6️⃣ AL AIR FRYER

Colocamos las tiras en la cesta sin amontonarlas y cocinamos a 180 ºC durante unos 15 minutos, dándoles la vuelta a mitad de tiempo si hace falta. Comprobamos que el interior alcance los 74 ºC.

7️⃣ PREPARAMOS LA SALSA

Mezclamos 2 cucharadas de mostaza, 1 cucharada de ketchup zero y 1 cucharada de miel hasta conseguir una salsa homogénea.

🍗 ¡Y YA ESTARÍA! Un pollo estilo KFC, jugoso por dentro y crujiente por fuera, con una salsa que está increíble y sin necesidad de freírlo en aceite.

text:
🧀🔥 Knusprige Schinken-Käse-Gurken-Röllchen aus dem Airfryer 🤤

Außen goldbraun und knusprig, innen geschmolzener Gouda, würziger Schinken und knackige Gewürzgurke – perfektes Fingerfood!

⏱ Dauer: ca. 30 Minuten
🍽 Menge: 8 Röllchen

🛒 Zutaten:

Für die Röllchen:

* 8 Scheiben Kochschinken
* 4 Scheiben Gouda
* 2 mittelgroße Gewürzgurken
* mittelscharfer Senf (ca. ½ TL pro Röllchen)

Für die Panade:

* 4 EL Mehl
* 2 Eier
* ca. 100 g Paniermehl
* etwas Öl oder Ölspray

👨‍🍳 Zubereitung:

1️⃣ Gurken vorbereiten:
Gewürzgurken trocken tupfen und jeweils längs in 4 Stifte schneiden.

2️⃣ Röllchen füllen:
Schinkenscheiben dünn mit Senf bestreichen. Jeweils eine halbe Scheibe Gouda und einen Gurkenstift darauflegen. Fest aufrollen und bei Bedarf mit Zahnstochern fixieren.

3️⃣ Panierstraße vorbereiten:
Mehl, verquirlte Eier und Paniermehl in drei separate Schalen geben.

4️⃣ Doppelt panieren:
Röllchen zuerst in Mehl, dann in Ei und Paniermehl wenden. Anschließend nochmals durch Ei und Paniermehl ziehen. Die Brösel gut andrücken.

5️⃣ Kühlen:
Die Röllchen für ca. 10–15 Minuten in den Kühlschrank stellen.

6️⃣ Airfryer:
Bei 190 °C ca. 8–12 Minuten goldbraun backen. Nach 5–6 Minuten vorsichtig wenden und rundherum leicht mit Öl besprühen.

7️⃣ Servieren:
Kurz ruhen lassen, Zahnstocher entfernen und direkt genießen.

😋 Fertig!
Außen knusprig, innen käsig und würzig – der perfekte Snack! 🔥.          #airfryer #foodtok #crunchy #käse #snack

text:
Como fazer frango crocante na airfryer - Frango HashBrown 🤯🔥

Ingredientes: 👇
2 peitos de frango
3 ovos
200 ml de leite
Suco de 1 limão
Mostarda a gosto
Sal a gosto
Lemon pepper a gosto
Páprica a gosto
Amido de milho
4 batatas
80 g de parmesão ralado
Óleo para borrifar

Preparo:

Divida o peito de frango ao meio para formar filés mais finos.

Para a marinada, misture os ovos, leite, limão, mostarda, sal, lemon pepper, páprica e amido de milho.

Coloque os filés nessa mistura e deixe marinar por 30 minutos.

Rale as batatas e lave bem até a água sair transparente, retirando o excesso de amido.

Esprema muito bem e seque com papel-toalha. Depois misture com o parmesão ralado.

Retire o frango da marinada, cubra com a mistura de batata e parmesão e aperte bem para grudar.

Borrife um pouco de óleo e leve para a airfryer a 180 °C por cerca de 25 minutos, ou até ficar bem dourado e crocante.

Por fora fica uma casquinha absurda e por dentro o frango continua suculento. Faz aí que é sucesso garantido!

text:
Honey Sriracha Chicken Fried Rice

Air Fryer Only,
Episode 1

Per Serving (Makes 5):
615 Calories
50g Protein
65g Carbs
17g Fat

——

HONEY SRIRACHA CHICKEN
900g skinless chicken thighs (32oz)
60g sriracha (4 Tbsp)
50g honey (2.5 Tbsp)
30g soy sauce (2 Tbsp)
15g tomato paste (1 Tbsp)
15g ginger paste (1 Tbsp)
15g rice vinegar (1 Tbsp)
Garlic, pepper, salt to taste

VEGGIES:
336g frozen mukimame* (12oz)
Or any frozen veggies of choice

RICE
300g / ~2 cups Jasmine rice (dry weight)

LOW-CAL SRIRACHA MAYO:**
50g low-fat mayo (3 Tbsp)
50g 0% greek yogurt (3 Tbsp)
35g sriracha (2 Tbsp)
5g honey (1 tsp)
Salt, pepper, garlic powder to taste
Add milk until desired consistency

GARNISH/FINISHING INGREDIENTS:
2 stalks of green onions 
30g soy sauce (2 Tbsp)
15g toasted sesame oil (1 Tbsp)
White/black sesame seeds

*microwave steam frozen veggies before adding to air fryer

**I recommend doubling the sauce recipe and adding to a sauce bottle for use through the week!

—

Instructions:

1.) Combine sriracha, soy sauce, tomato paste, ginger paste, honey, rice vinegar, and seasonings. Add chicken thighs and toss to coat. Marinate for at least 15 mins, up to overnight.

2.) Start cooking rice in a rice cooker or on the stovetop (so rice finishes at the same time as everything else) 

3.) Preheat air fryer to 400°F. Cook chicken for 20–25 mins, flip halfway, until cooked through and browned.

4.) Remove chicken and the air fryer rack. Steam frozen mukimame/veggies of choice in microwave to soften. Add veggies directly into the rendered juices in the air fryer basket. Air fry at 400°F for 8–10 mins.

5.) While veggies finish, whisk together all low-cal sriracha mayo ingredients, thinning with milk until drizzleable. Chop chicken into bite sized pieces.

5.) Add cooked rice, soy sauce, toasted sesame oil, chopped chicken, and sliced green onions to the veggies. Toss everything together until evenly combined.

Portion into 5 bowls or meal prep containers

Drizzle with sriracha mayo, garnish with sesame seeds and green onions, and enjoy!

Homemade Pizza (Easy & No Knead)

Made in the @cottolio Naples Air Fryer!

Ingredients

* 250g flour (about 2 cups)
* 175g water (about ¾ cup)
* 1 tsp yeast
* 1 tsp sugar
* 1 tsp salt
* 1 tbsp olive oil

Instructions

1. In a bowl, mix the yeast, sugar, and water. Add the flour and salt, then mix until a dough forms. Add 1 tbsp olive oil and do several coil folds. Cover and let rest for 20 minutes.
2. Do another round of coil folds, then cover and let the dough rise for 1 hour.
3. Transfer the dough onto floured parchment paper without deflating it. Gently shape it into a ball, sprinkle flour on top, cover, and let rest for 40 minutes.
4. Gently flatten the center of the dough, keeping the middle thin and the edges thick. Spread pizza sauce over the dough, then add shredded cheese.
5. Bake in the Cottolio Naples Air Fryer using the Pizza setting until the crust is golden and the cheese is melted.

Crispy airfryer sweet chilli chicken wraps! These are a perfect for a high protein easy tasty healthy lunch with 39g protein per wrap. 

Ingredients:
2 chicken breasts cut into large strips
1 small egg or 3 tbsp sriracha 
1 tsp garlic powder 
1 tsp smoked paprika
1 tsp chilli powder
Baby gem lettuce
Cucumber 
Small red onion
60g crushed cornflakes 
2 tbsp reduced sugar sweet chilli sauce or sweet chilli sauce
2 tbsp low fat mayo
Extra Large wrap 

Cut the chicken into strips and season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, smoked paprika and chilli powder in a bowl. 

Add in one small whisked egg to the bowl and mix. If you don’t like egg you can use a sticky sauce like spicy sriracha. 

Crush your cornflakes onto a plate and dip each chicken strip so it’s crumbed all over. Spray with oil. Preheat airfryer to 180c. Cook the chicken for 18 minutes (or till cooked). 

While the chicken is cooking, slice up your lettuce, quarter of a cucumber and quarter of a red onion. 

Make your sauce - mix the sweet chilli sauce and mayo with 1 tbsp water. Make more sauce if you need! 

Get a big wrap - the usual supermarket tortilla wraps might be too small (I got these in a local Turkish supermarket). Place your salad in the middle, layer on the crispy chicken and drizzle on the sauce. 

To wrap, fold in the sides first and pull the bottom of the wrap over the top of the ingredients - tuck tightly and roll forward till it’s fully wrapped. 

Toast in a pan both sides, slice and enjoy!

🍗 Easy Air Fryer Chicken & Veggies

🛒 Ingredients:

* 4–6 chicken drumsticks
* 4 potatoes, sliced
* 2 carrots, sliced
* 1 onion, sliced
* Cauliflower florets
* Sliced mushrooms
* 2–3 tbsp mayonnaise
* 1–2 tbsp olive oil
* Salt and black pepper, to taste
* Paprika, to taste
* Italian herbs, to taste

👩‍🍳 Instructions:

1. Peel and slice the potatoes, carrots, and onion. Cut the cauliflower into florets and slice the mushrooms.
2. Add the mayonnaise, olive oil, salt, pepper, paprika, and Italian herbs. Mix everything well with the vegetables and chicken.
3. Place the vegetables in the air fryer basket and arrange the chicken drumsticks on top.
4. Air fry at 180°C (350°F) for 35–45 minutes, turning the chicken halfway through and stirring the vegetables.
5. Cook until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 74°C (165°F) and the vegetables are tender and golden.
